patch_list: Adds Settings > Pictures > "Disable post-processing". When on, each shot is a single frame instead of a multi-frame burst (no multi-frame merge or HDR stacking for RAW and JPEG), saved right away without the "Refining image" notification.…

Lets a re-signed Expert RAW run on a stock Galaxy: calls that need Samsung's platform signature are made safe, private storage under /data/sec is moved to app storage and Samsung's private media provider is emulated with MediaStore. Voice…
